cc:Work.dc:title: Bishop Concept (MONOLITH Edition - v1.0)
cc:Work.dc:description: The bishop of the tall MONOLITH concept set, drawn to stand beside Dennis's castle-concept.svg: a pen-nib mitre of two petals joined at the tip, a see-through slot above a glass orb belted in gold, and a gold staff running down a tapered body to a disc, on the castle's two-tier plinth with its glowing door. Same 10 px black outline, palette, scale and baseline as the castle.
